method: Actual unchanged bundled THREE Vector2.length/normalize and Elf.setup/update in CPU VM. IEEE754 bit-string inputs/output preserve signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN class. Per-case explicit origin0/speed/waypoint. Elf direct update, held model/GLTF IO, Canvas/input/collision/LOD registration adapters; no full PlayerSystem/renderer/browser/GPU/window/input. Native test executes its actual Player stage for movement.
limits: NaN payload/sign is not a JavaScript numeric contract; compare NaN class, not payload bits.
Angles use 1e-12 tolerance for cross-libm atan2; path count and vector bits otherwise exact.
Generic invalid-number grid/path/collision/render/network behavior is outside this vector/Elf fixture.
No full animated Model/graphics/audio/input or whole-match parity claim.
